description.value: If the Boneless Dancer is subjected to an effect that allows it to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, the Boneless Dancer instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the saving throw, and only half damage if it fails.
The Boneless Dancer has advantage on attack rolls against any creature grappled by it.

The Boneless Dancer slams a creature grappled by it into a solid surface. The creature must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or take 10 (2d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage and be stunned until the end of the Boneless Dancer's next turn.

On a successful save, the target takes half the bludgeoning damage and isn't stunned.

Recharges on 6.

The Boneless Dancer slams a creature grappled by it into a solid surface. The creature must make a Constitution saving throw.

If damage reduces the Boneless Dancer to 0 hit points, it must make a Constitution saving throw with a DC of 5 + the damage taken, unless the damage is radiant or from a critical hit. On a success, the Boneless Dancer drops to 1 hit point instead.

If damage reduces the Boneless Dancer to 0 hit points, it must make a Constitution saving throw.

When the Boneless Dancer dies it dissolves into shadow and smoke, leaving behind no corpse. Afterward, a new boneless dancer will coalesce out of the gloom and darkness nearby a few moments later (1d4 boneless dancers reform at the end of each combat round).

The Boneless Dancer will continue reappearing after death as long as its reflection in the material world remains undefeated.
The Boneless Dancer adds 2 to its Armor Class against one melee Attack that would otherwise hit it.

Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage and the target is grappled (DC 13). Until this grapple ends, the Boneless Dancer can't attempt to grapple another target.

The Boneless Dancer grasps you with both arms in a constricting embrace.

Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, 10 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

The Boneless Dancer extends an impossibly long leg to lash out at you.
The Boneless Dancer makes one Grasping Hands and one Reaching Kick attack.
